$comment: Scripted reviewer corrections, replayed between stages to check that a correction is
honoured by everything downstream and never contradicted.
`path` uses the same dotted vocabulary as flattenStagedReviewVersion in routes/api.js,
so fixtures, the production edit analytics and the replay harness all name a field the
same way. `appliesTo` names transcript directories under scripts/.
Each scenario is a case that was observed failing, not an invented one. The finding it
covers is recorded so a change to the scenario has to argue with the bug it came from.
expect.preserved  - text that must appear, verbatim, in the named downstream stage
expect.absent     - text that must not appear anywhere downstream
expect.noOtherBucket - confirmed facts must not be filed under a card titled 'Other'

scenarios.finding: bestAuthoritativeTopicForFact scores a confirmed fact against the renamed label, falls below 0.18 and files it under 'Other' with no flag
scenarios.intent: The reviewer renames a topic heading into their own words.

scenarios.finding: summaryScreen published the re-derived purpose and never state.meeting.purpose; the browser then copied it back over the reviewer's field
scenarios.intent: The reviewer rewrites the meeting purpose wholesale.

edits.to: Agree who carries the importer obligations for DITA and what evidence HPRA will expect.

preserved.text: Agree who carries the importer obligations for DITA and what evidence HPRA will expect.

scenarios.finding: isPublishableTopicLabel rejects a pronoun; the confirmedTopic exemption was set only on the branch the reviewer-confirmed path does not take
scenarios.intent: The reviewer writes a heading the way a person would.

scenarios.finding: the same gate rejects any auxiliary or modal, so 'CAN bus integration' fails on the word 'can'
scenarios.intent: A real subject whose name collides with a modal verb.

scenarios.finding: stagedSemanticAuthority hits a bare `continue` when a confirmed fact has no lexical support, skipping both the repair and the flag
scenarios.intent: The reviewer records something they know that the meeting only alluded to.

edits.to: The HPRA registration renewal falls due in November.

preserved.text: The HPRA registration renewal falls due in November.

scenarios.finding: finaliseDiscussionPointForMinutes deletes any point containing we/our/you via FIRST_PERSON_TRANSCRIPT_VOICE
scenarios.intent: The reviewer writes a point in the voice they actually use.

edits.to: We owe the client a written procedure before the next call.

preserved.text: We owe the client a written procedure before the next call.

scenarios.finding: cleanDiscussionDisplayText returns '' for any point with a speaker prefix, deleting it on re-render
scenarios.intent: The reviewer notes who owes what, in the shorthand they would write by hand.

edits.to: Mark: chase the declaration of conformity pack.

preserved.text: Mark: chase the declaration of conformity pack.

scenarios.finding: the recovered-owner regex required two capitalised words, so a first name became 'Not stated' and the publication gate then dropped the action
scenarios.intent: The reviewer assigns an action to someone by first name.

scenarios.finding: entityNames was built from transcript speakers only, so a corrected spelling was normalised back to the recorder's
scenarios.intent: The reviewer fixes a name the recorder mis-transcribed.

scenarios.finding: grammarPolishStagedExecutiveSummary ran over reviewer prose as well as model prose
scenarios.intent: The reviewer writes the executive summary themselves.

edits.to: We agreed the procedure work lands with us and the registration evidence lands with the client.

preserved.text: We agreed the procedure work lands with us and the registration evidence lands with the client.

scenarios.finding: the browser injects 'Review this section against the transcript.' into an emptied card, and it persists into stagedState and the PDF
scenarios.intent: The reviewer deletes a discussion section they judge not worth minuting.

absent: Review this section against the transcript.

scenarios.finding: confirmed objectives were stored and never read back; a re-run returned the derived list
scenarios.intent: The reviewer rewrites the objectives, then regenerates the summary.

to: Agree the audit scope and who covers the software track
Confirm what the client must have ready before we arrive

preserved.text: Agree the audit scope and who covers the software track
Confirm what the client must have ready before we arrive
